LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]], original Japanese card face in a PSA holder.<ref name="photograph">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-premiere-japanese/imagegallery/724984 PSA collector gallery]; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/197026802/3nuThsjW2UGb0DlnFR0hZQ.jpg original photograph].</ref>

The PSA holder label says LIN-V8M; the physical card face clearly says LIN-V8K. Card identity follows the face and checklist, not the holder label.<ref name="photograph" />
